description: Scaffold for T2/T3 brane-tower trace reformulation per the gist framework (https://gist.github.com/litlfred/b3459bf9143dd03234a9fc55c370f6f4). Demonstrates that Phi_q(z) admits a Plancherel-series expansion Sum_n z^n / (q; q)_n where each term factors through tr_M(sigma_i^n) — restoring Markov-invariance term-by-term. Convergence is slow near |z| -> q_0 (radius of convergence); Wynn-eps / Pade acceleration likely needed for production. Not yet wired into the 6-term formula; depends on PR #526's term-trace infrastructure.
notes: Plancherel coefficients c_n(q_0) alternate in sign (1 - q^k < 0 for k>=1).
Partial sums oscillate; series convergence is conditionally slow.
Each truncated partial sum is Markov-invariant — structural win over Phi_q(|V|) closed form.
